# Two components each building an instance named `#b` under a reactive `if`
# compile and run on every target a test can execute on:
# testdata/instance_id_in_two_components.txtar is the code.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output {
    go {
        bubbletea
        fyne
        gtk4
    }
    kotlin {
        android
    }
    none {
        html
    }
}
component badge(label string) node {
    var hits = 0
    button #hit(text="{label}{hits}", @click { hits = hits + 1 })
}

component panel node {
    var on = true
    vbox {
        button #flip(text="f", @click { on = !on })
        if on {
            badge #b(label="p")
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var shown = true
    var other = false
    vbox {
        button #ts(text="s", @click { shown = !shown })
        button #to(text="o", @click { other = !other })
        if shown {
            badge #b(label="m")
        }
        if other {
            panel
        }
    }
}

func testBothInstancesRender(t Test, c main) {
    c.ts.click()
    c.to.click()
    t.assert(c.other)
}

window {
    main
}
